body:
**CL term**
[CL_0000999](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0000999) — CD4-positive CD11b-positive dendritic cell

**Suggested revision of class hierarchy**
Change the Equivalent To class from `conventional dendritic cell` to [CD11b-positive dendritic cell](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0002465).

**Rationale**  
Currently, CD4-positive CD11b-positive dendritic cell (CL_0000999) has `conventional dendritic cell` as its Equivalent To class. We propose changing it to CD11b-positive dendritic cell. This change reflects a more natural hierarchical relationship, as CD11b-positive dendritic cell represents a parent concept encompassing CD4-positive CD11b-positive dendritic cell.

A concrete example supporting this change is already present in the ontology: CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative, CD11b-positive dendritic cell (CL_0002454) uses CD11b-positive dendritic cell as its Equivalent To class. Applying the same principle here ensures consistency and aligns with existing ontology modeling practices.

Thank you for your consideration.
title: [Class hierarchy] CD4+ CD11b+ dendritic cell [CL_0000999]: Change parent to CD11b+ DC
